import sys, os, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/data/scripts')
import spotter_campaign_acl as acl

# The single write path for the campaign registry, and therefore the real
# enforcement point for ownership and the per-user campaign cap. All rules --
# merge-by-id, "never drop ids missing from the payload", owner stamping, quota
# -- live in scripts/spotter_campaign_acl.merge_save().
try:
    user = acl.caller(_items)
    if not user:
        return [{'json': {'campaigns': [], 'error': 'unauthenticated'}}]

    body = acl.body_of(_items)
    merged, info = acl.merge_save(
        acl.read_campaigns(), body.get('campaigns'), body.get('delete_id'), user)
    acl.write_campaigns(merged)

    # Return only what this operator may see -- the client overwrites its local
    # cache with this array, so returning the full registry would leak it.
    out = {'campaigns': acl.visible(merged, user), 'user': user}
    out.update(info)
    return [{'json': out}]
except Exception as e:
    return [{'json': {'campaigns': [], 'error': str(e)[:400]}}]

meta.notes: POST /webhook/save-campaigns {campaigns:[...]} to upsert-by-id, or {delete_id} to remove one. Persists the SHARED campaign registry to the global Neo4j node (:SpotterMeta {key:'campaigns'}). Upsert never drops ids missing from the payload (deletion is explicit via delete_id) so a stale client cannot wipe another operator's campaigns. Returns the merged {campaigns:[...]}. Paired with list-campaigns (WF17).
